scripts.build:strict: npm run generate:api && NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build 2>&1 | tee build.log; if grep -q 'error' build.log || [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -ne 0 ]; then echo '❌ Build failed with errors' && exit 1; fi
scripts.generate:api:check: npm run generate:api && git diff --exit-code src/api/schema.d.ts || (echo '❌ Schema is out of sync. Commit the changes.' && exit 1)
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run type-check && npm run test
scripts.ci: npm run validate && npm run build:strict
